key_insight: A PANS simulation can capture the curvature-driven turbulence behavior in annular Poiseuille flow with accuracy comparable to DNS and other RANS-based scale-resolving methods.
engineering_relevance: This suggests a lower-cost modeling route for heat-exchanger and annular duct designs where inner-wall curvature strongly affects turbulent transport.
method: Simulated turbulent annular Poiseuille flow using the Partially-Averaged Navier-Stokes (PANS) model
Studied the effect of transverse wall curvature via the radius ratio η = Ri/Ro
Benchmarked performance at ReDh = 8900 against DNS and other RANS-based scale-resolving approaches
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that PANS reproduces curvature effects in the flowfield with performance comparable to DNS and similar scale-resolving methods.
watch_item: The result is shown for a single Reynolds number and geometry range, so broader validation is needed before generalizing to other annular-flow conditions.
paper_title: Partially-Averaged Navier-Stokes simulation of turbulent annular Poiseulle flow
